owner_notes: Local only; at least 16 GB RAM advised (laptop has 191 GB). No tenant sign-in. The two DAX Studio screens (perf-server-timings, perf-vertipaq) are optional and not in the published video: see optional_screens. DAX Studio (free): the All Users install via winget needs your UAC approval (gives the External Tools button); without it the set-up statements there download the portable build into C:\MGLab\tools (no admin).

optional_screens.note: Not part of the published video (owner's decision of 22 Nov 2026: the two screens were not recorded when the video was rendered). script.yaml has no scene for these two screens, and no narration, slide or post refers to them. They are kept unchanged so they can be recorded later. To bring them back: add the two scenes to script.yaml again (git history of script.yaml, commit 4c8bef1), move the two entries below into "screens", and append "prepare" and "teardown" below to the lists of the same name at the top of this file. They cannot stay in "screens" meanwhile: check_record.py requires "screens" to match the screen scenes of script.yaml.
prepare: # owner: DAX Studio for All Users, once (UAC prompt: approve it yourself; it registers the External Tools button): winget install -e --id DaxStudio.DaxStudio --scope machine
$dsReg = Select-String -Path "${env:CommonProgramFiles(x86)}\Microsoft Shared\Power BI Desktop\External Tools\*.pbitool.json" -Pattern 'DaxStudio' -List -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

if (-not $dsReg -and -not (Test-Path C:\MGLab\tools\DaxStudio\DaxStudio.exe)) { $a = (Invoke-RestMethod https://api.github.com/repos/DaxStudio/DaxStudio/releases/latest).assets | Where-Object name -like '*portable*.zip' | Select-Object -First 1; Invoke-WebRequest $a.browser_download_url -OutFile C:\MGLab\tools\DaxStudio-portable.zip; Expand-Archive C:\MGLab\tools\DaxStudio-portable.zip C:\MGLab\tools\DaxStudio -Force; Get-ChildItem C:\MGLab\tools\DaxStudio -Recurse | Unblock-File }

if ($dsReg) { 'DAX Studio: External Tools button registered (' + $dsReg.Filename + ')' } elseif (Test-Path C:\MGLab\tools\DaxStudio\DaxStudio.exe) { 'DAX Studio: portable fallback in C:\MGLab\tools\DaxStudio (no External Tools button: use Connect > Power BI / SSDT Model)' } else { 'DAX Studio: NOT available - perf-server-timings and perf-vertipaq cannot be recorded' }

screens.name: perf-server-timings
steps: Power BI Desktop: ContosoPerf.After.pbip open and refreshed (from the perf-after screen)

External Tools ribbon > DAX Studio: it opens already connected (status bar: localhost:<port>). Fallback (portable build): start C:\MGLab\tools\DaxStudio\DaxStudio.exe > Connect > Power BI / SSDT Model > pick ContosoPerf.After > Connect
Dismiss any version-notification popup; zoom the editor (Ctrl + mouse wheel) so the query is readable
Home ribbon: switch on Server Timings and Clear on Run (cold cache for every run)
File > Open > type C:\MGLab\power-bi\ep08\src\queries\04-server-timings-yoy-twice.dax > Open; Run (F5); open the Server Timings tab: Total, FE, SE, SE queries, SE cache and the xmSQL list; hold
Open 05-server-timings-yoy-var.dax the same way; Run; Server Timings tab; hold. Write both sets of numbers down (Total, FE, SE, SE queries)
Advanced ribbon > Run Benchmark on the 05 tab: 5 cold, 5 warm > Run; Summary tab; hold. Repeat on the 04 tab
Do not save anything to the model; leave DAX Studio open for perf-vertipaq
mask: account name and picture at the top right of Power BI Desktop (sign out first)
DAX Studio: never open File > Recent / the start page list; do not sign in to any account in DAX Studio (top right stays empty)
Windows user name in the Import/Export Metrics file dialogs (type the C:\MGLab path in the File name box, do not browse the nav pane)
screens.note: Narration is number-free: report the real Server Timings and benchmark numbers so the README and social posts can quote them.

screens.name: perf-vertipaq
steps: (off camera, during the perf-before/perf-sizes session, Before model open) External Tools > DAX Studio > Advanced > Export Metrics > File name C:\MGLab\power-bi\ep08\src\results\ContosoPerf.Before.vpax > Save. If perf-before is not re-recorded: open ContosoPerf.Before.pbip, Refresh, export, close it, then reopen the After model
On camera, DAX Studio connected to ContosoPerf.After: Advanced > View Metrics > OK in Metric Options (defaults)
Summary tab: total size; hold. Columns tab: sort by Total Size descending; hold

Advanced > Import Metrics > File name C:\MGLab\power-bi\ep08\src\results\ContosoPerf.Before.vpax > Open; Columns tab sorted by Total Size: Line Ref, Order Timestamp, Order Number, Note on top; Summary tab: total size; hold
Write down both totals and the top five columns of each (record the real numbers)
Close DAX Studio without saving the query tabs
mask: account name and picture at the top right of Power BI Desktop (sign out first)
DAX Studio: never open File > Recent / the start page list; do not sign in to any account in DAX Studio (top right stays empty)
Windows user name in the Import/Export Metrics file dialogs (type the C:\MGLab path in the File name box, do not browse the nav pane)

teardown: # DAX Studio stays installed; to remove the portable fallback: Remove-Item C:\MGLab\tools\DaxStudio, C:\MGLab\tools\DaxStudio-portable.zip -Recurse -Force
